ios.desc:
Construct 3D models by combining and fine-tuning properties of 3D primitives.  Paint models with custom materials (or select from a library of material presets) in the Painting Studio.

Designed to be as simple as possible – great for kids and novices to 3D modeling.

Includes powerful editing tools & features like the Properties Editor, Material Previewer, Parts List, primitive grouping, property sliders, property text input, and much more.

Export projects easily for 3D printing, popular gaming & physics engines, sharing with friends via Airdrop, editing via text-editor, or editing in another 3D modeling application.  Exporting as Minima Model files keeps files sizes low and makes sharing easy.

Includes detailed Help Center with walkthroughs for solving urgent technical questions.

Part of the MINIMA Suite of powerful, accessible creative tools for the iPad and Mac.  Includes cross-platform integration with Mac version of Minima Sculptor.
